items.title: Treat injuries in the Cure menu

title_i18n.en: Treat injuries in the Cure menu

items.description: Inspect each injury and apply the needed treatment; restoring life alone does not remove an untreated wound.

description_i18n.en: Inspect each injury and apply the needed treatment; restoring life alone does not remove an untreated wound.

items.details:
Open the Survival Viewer and choose Cure after major damage, a poison hit or a difficult water crossing. Inspect the affected body part and apply the treatments shown for the injury. Remove embedded objects when required and finish every listed step rather than spending medical supplies at random.

Food restores stamina, while untreated wounds can continue to limit recovery. Keep reliable food, medical supplies and weapon ammunition as separate resources in your planning. Learn the PS2 menu controls during a quiet moment so an unfamiliar treatment screen does not interrupt an important encounter.

details_i18n.en:
Open the Survival Viewer and choose Cure after major damage, a poison hit or a difficult water crossing. Inspect the affected body part and apply the treatments shown for the injury. Remove embedded objects when required and finish every listed step rather than spending medical supplies at random.

Food restores stamina, while untreated wounds can continue to limit recovery. Keep reliable food, medical supplies and weapon ammunition as separate resources in your planning. Learn the PS2 menu controls during a quiet moment so an unfamiliar treatment screen does not interrupt an important encounter.
details_i18n.pt:
Abra o Survival Viewer e escolha Cure após dano forte, um golpe venenoso ou uma travessia difícil na água. Examine a parte afetada e aplique os tratamentos mostrados para a lesão. Remova objetos encravados quando necessário e conclua todas as etapas indicadas, em vez de gastar suprimentos médicos ao acaso.

A comida restaura vigor, enquanto ferimentos sem tratamento podem continuar limitando a recuperação. Planeje alimentos confiáveis, suprimentos médicos e munição como recursos separados. Aprenda os controles dos menus do PS2 durante um momento tranquilo para a tela de tratamento não interromper um encontro importante.

items.details:
Treat the duel as a search across connected maps. Begin by checking likely elevated positions with your eyes and Directional Microphone. Once he relocates, Thermal Goggles can reveal his footprints, letting you approach from a quieter angle.

Avoid firing simply because you see foliage move. Confirm the target, take a controlled shot and relocate before his return fire. Replenish stamina as needed. For the normal duel route, stay in the encounter rather than relying on real-world clock tricks or an early kill, which can bypass the fight and its normal rewards.

details_i18n.en:
Treat the duel as a search across connected maps. Begin by checking likely elevated positions with your eyes and Directional Microphone. Once he relocates, Thermal Goggles can reveal his footprints, letting you approach from a quieter angle.

Avoid firing simply because you see foliage move. Confirm the target, take a controlled shot and relocate before his return fire. Replenish stamina as needed. For the normal duel route, stay in the encounter rather than relying on real-world clock tricks or an early kill, which can bypass the fight and its normal rewards.
details_i18n.pt:
Trate o duelo como uma busca por mapas conectados. Comece observando posições elevadas prováveis e usando o Microfone Direcional. Depois que ele mudar de lugar, os Óculos Térmicos podem revelar pegadas e permitir uma aproximação mais silenciosa.

Não atire apenas porque a vegetação se mexeu. Confirme o alvo, faça um disparo controlado e mude de posição antes da resposta. Reponha vigor quando necessário. Para seguir o duelo normal, permaneça no encontro em vez de depender de truques com o relógio ou de uma eliminação antecipada, que podem pular a luta e suas recompensas normais.

items.details:
The apparent game-over screen is part of this encounter. Do not immediately choose Continue: access the item menu while the screen is active and select the Revival Pill to return Snake to the living world.

If you want to experience the full river sequence, walk to its far end before reviving. The apparitions reflect earlier kills, so a violent playthrough can make the crossing more crowded. This is not a conventional gunfight; conserve ammunition and concentrate on the path and the final item-menu action.

details_i18n.en:
The apparent game-over screen is part of this encounter. Do not immediately choose Continue: access the item menu while the screen is active and select the Revival Pill to return Snake to the living world.

If you want to experience the full river sequence, walk to its far end before reviving. The apparitions reflect earlier kills, so a violent playthrough can make the crossing more crowded. This is not a conventional gunfight; conserve ammunition and concentrate on the path and the final item-menu action.
details_i18n.pt:
A aparente tela de fim de jogo faz parte do encontro. Não escolha Continue imediatamente: acesse o menu de itens enquanto a tela estiver ativa e selecione a Revival Pill para devolver Snake ao mundo dos vivos.

Se quiser ver a sequência completa do rio, chegue ao fim antes de reviver. As aparições refletem mortes anteriores, então uma campanha violenta pode deixar a travessia mais cheia. Não é uma luta convencional de tiros; economize munição e concentre-se no caminho e na ação final pelo menu de itens.

items.description: Face her approach and time the CQC counter to her grab; follow a successful throw with a short attack, then separate before she recovers.

items.details:
Keep The Boss in view and listen for the approach that precedes her CQC attack. Time your counter to the grab instead of repeatedly pressing the control. Once she falls, land a brief follow-up and make room before she stands.

If you prefer distance, break line of sight behind trees and wait for a clear opening. Use first-person aiming deliberately with the original fixed camera; Subsistence offers a free camera, but the fight and its objectives are the same. For a stamina victory, keep your attacks nonlethal. The required story action after the duel is separate from the fighting method.

details_i18n.en:
Keep The Boss in view and listen for the approach that precedes her CQC attack. Time your counter to the grab instead of repeatedly pressing the control. Once she falls, land a brief follow-up and make room before she stands.

If you prefer distance, break line of sight behind trees and wait for a clear opening. Use first-person aiming deliberately with the original fixed camera; Subsistence offers a free camera, but the fight and its objectives are the same. For a stamina victory, keep your attacks nonlethal. The required story action after the duel is separate from the fighting method.
details_i18n.pt:
Mantenha The Boss à vista e escute a aproximação que antecede seu ataque de CQC. Acerte o contra-ataque no momento do agarrão em vez de apertar o controle repetidamente. Quando ela cair, faça um ataque breve e abra espaço antes de ela levantar.

Se preferir distância, interrompa a linha de visão atrás das árvores e espere uma abertura clara. Use a mira em primeira pessoa com cuidado na câmera fixa original; Subsistence oferece câmera livre, mas a luta e seus objetivos são os mesmos. Para vencer por vigor, mantenha os ataques não letais. A ação obrigatória da história após o duelo é separada da abordagem de combate.
